name: Slack
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded direct-message, mention, and thread-reply context from conversations visible to a Slack token.

categories.label: Direct messages
categories.description: Recent messages in visible one-to-one and group direct messages.

categories.label: Mentions
categories.description: Recent visible messages containing your Slack user mention token.

categories.label: Thread replies
categories.description: Recent replies in a bounded set of visible active threads.

setup.summary: Uses a Slack bot or user token. Visibility is limited by token scopes and conversation membership; no workspace-wide access is implied.

fields.label: Slack token
fields.description: A bot or user token with the read/history scopes for the conversation types you want included.

fields.label: Conversation scan limit
fields.description: Maximum visible conversations scanned per sync, from 1 to 8 (default 8).
